get.summary: Saved addresses, grouped by type with the default first.

post.summary: Save an address. Marking it default replaces the previous default of the same type.

delete.summary: Delete a saved address. Past orders are unaffected (they hold a snapshot).

get.summary: One saved address.

patch.summary: Change an address. Orders keep the snapshot taken at checkout.

get.summary: Current stock levels. The ETag header carries the version required to update them.

patch.summary: Set stock on hand. Requires If-Match with the current ETag (optimistic concurrency): 412 if the stock changed since it was read, 428 if If-Match is missing, 409 if the new level would fall below stock already reserved by checkouts.

get.summary: All orders, newest first, optionally filtered by status, with each order's customer and the actions an administrator may take next.
Any order, with the customer's email.

post.summary: Refund the order's payment in full through Stripe. 409 if the order cannot be refunded in its current state (checked before any money moves); 502 if Stripe did not complete it.
Move a paid order through fulfilment: fulfilling, shipped, delivered. The database rejects illegal jumps (409 invalid_status_transition). Recorded in the status history with the admin.

get.summary: All products, including inactive ones, with stock levels. Keyset-paged by id.

patch.summary: Change a product's price or availability. Price changes are recorded in price_history by a trigger.

get.summary: The customer's price alerts, newest first, with each product's current price.

post.summary: Watch a product for a price at or below the target (below today's price). One alert per product: setting it again changes the target and re-arms it. One email when it fires.
Exchange credentials for an access token and a refresh cookie.
End this session (the refresh token family in the cookie). Always succeeds.
End every session for the authenticated user, on every device.

get.summary: The authenticated user's profile.

patch.summary: Change the account's name. Email changes are not offered (the address is the login).

post.summary: Change the password, given the current one. Every other session is signed out; this one stays.
Email a single-use reset link. The answer is the same whether or not the address has an account (no enumeration), and requests are limited per address and per client.
Set a new password with the emailed token. The token works once; every session of the account is signed out, and the account owner is told by email.
Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access token. Reusing a rotated token ends the session.
Create a customer account.

get.summary: All brands, alphabetically.
The user's builds, most recently changed first.

post.summary: Start a new, empty build.

get.summary: Builds the store recommends (public, featured and validated), with parts and totals. No sign-in needed.

delete.summary: Delete a build. Ordered builds cannot be deleted (409 build_locked).

get.summary: A build with its parts, prices and status.

post.summary: Add a part. 409 if the build already holds the maximum of that kind, already contains the product, or has been ordered. A validated build returns to draft.

delete.summary: Remove a part and return the updated build.

post.summary: Check a saved build and record the outcome: the build becomes validated only when it is both compatible (no conflicts) and complete (nothing missing); otherwise it returns to draft.

delete.summary: Empty the cart. Lines saved for later stay saved.

get.summary: The caller's cart with live prices, stock and VAT-inclusive totals. Reserves nothing.

post.summary: Add a product. Adding one already in the cart increases its quantity (up to 99).

patch.summary: Set a line's quantity, or move it to saved for later and back. Saved lines stay in the cart but are left out of the totals, the item count and checkout.

get.summary: The browsing taxonomy as a tree. Leaf categories carry the component kind they sell.

post.description: 409 insufficient_stock lists each short line; 409 build_not_validated if the build is not both compatible and complete. Unpaid orders release their stock at reservation_expires_at.
post.summary: Reserve stock and create a pending_payment order from the cart or a validated build.
Check a list of parts without saving anything, e.g. while a visitor configures a build.

get.summary: The kinds of part a build is made of, in display order, with per-build limits.
Settings the browser needs at runtime. Contains nothing secret: the Stripe publishable key is public by design. Served at runtime so one image works in every environment.
Liveness: the process is up and serving requests.
Readiness: PostgreSQL and Redis are reachable. 503 while any dependency is down.
The user's orders, newest first.
One order with its lines, totals, address, payment status and status history.

post.summary: Cancel an order that is still awaiting payment; its stock is released immediately.
Start (or resume) payment for an unpaid order. Safe to repeat: the same PaymentIntent is returned each time. 503 if the payment provider is unavailable; try again shortly.

Add an order's items to the cart (checkout empties the cart, so this is how a customer checks out again after an unpaid order's hold expires, or buys the same parts again). Products no longer sold are skipped and listed in unavailable_product_ids.
